reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is url from session attribute 'partnerCallback'. The redirect has two defenses: (1) url must start with 'https://' AND (2) url must contain the configured suffix from initParameter 'partner.domain.suffix'. The session attribute is server-set (not user-input), and the suffix is config-based. Combined with HTTPS-only requirement, this limits redirect scope significantly. On the executed path, the resolved sink value passes through multiple gates before reaching sendRedirect(), making exploitation unlikely through normal request flows.

evidence.note: Session attribute retrieval and HTTPS/suffix validation guards before redirect
